svg.text: One I2C bus daisy-chained over STEMMA QT: QT Py → OLED → IMU → light.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Addresses: OLED 0x3D (0x3C with jumper), BMI270 0x68, VEML7700 0x10.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The display moves to I2C, so goggl1's SPI driver needs an I2C path;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 400 kHz a full 1 KB frame takes about 25 ms.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: QT Py ESP32-C3 is often out of stock. The Seeed XIAO ESP32C3

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: works too but needs headers soldered and a QT→header cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Optional: SPI display on the QT Py

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the 938's two jumpers and solder its header, then:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SCK GPIO10 → Clk · MO GPIO7 → Data · A0 GPIO4 → CS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A1 GPIO3 → DC · A2 GPIO1 → Rst · 3V → Vin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On the bench the QT Py's own USB-C powers everything; the puck is optional.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Puck mode needs one soldered header on the QT Py's 5V / GND.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the 4755 charge jumper to 500 mA. Keep LOAD off the 3V pin.
